row.title: The seed carries the definition of an Ultrastable system, enforced (SYSTEM-1)
row.body: seed/doctrine/system-contract.json defines what a system is, how it runs, the bootstrap stages, the ignition ladder to criticality and one probed invariant per standing directive; seed/doctrine/SYSTEM.md is rendered from it and loaded first by seed/CLAUDE.md and the core CLAUDE.md; seed/scripts/contract.py --check runs in bootstrap.yml and core checks. A new standing directive becomes an invariant in the same change.

title: The seed carries the definition of an Ultrastable system, enforced (SYSTEM-1)
